newsitem.title: CHINA: China First Pencil to list rights issue.
newsitem.headline: China First Pencil to list rights issue.

text.p: China First Pencil Co will list its 41.415 million A and B shares rights issue on Thursday on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, a company statement in Monday's Shanghai Securities News said.
The company announced a 2.72-for-10 rights issue at a price of 2.49 yuan per share for A shares and $0.30 per share for foreign currency B shares in February, the statement said.

After the rights issue, the company will have a total of 193.676 million shares outstanding, of which 18.469 million or 9.54 percent are A shares and 92.347 million or 47.68 percent are B shares. The remaining 42.78 percent is non-tradable institution and state shares, the statement said.
The company's A shares ended on Friday at 12.62 yuan and its B shares at $0.572.
